kind: raster evidence, not authoritative current layout
pixel_coordinates: integer pixel indexes, not DIP; threshold bounds have at least ±1 pixel uncertainty
method: In a 35×35 ROI around nominal task center, retain RGBA pixels with 3<R-G<25, B-R>35 and A>200. Report half-open threshold bounding box; not fitted vector bounds.
interpretation: Raster centers are quantized/offset relative to nominal source coordinates; this old export also contains a different fork icon. Do not use it to overwrite current source dimensions or infer opacity.

brandIcon.method: Original 512px PNG; alpha thresholds 1 and 128; teal mask inside ROI x[90,422), y[150,362): A>=128, G-R>50, B-R>40. Half-open pixel boxes, not recovered vector geometry.
brandIcon.note: Windows tray loads the executable application icon. Mac template should use the Micro infinity brand, not the CODEX command-key glyph. A raster silhouette does not supply exact Bezier control points.
